slides.title: Why is the tape always missing in December? Finds for a wrap station.
slides.sub: One spot for all of it

slides.title: A rolling wrap cart
slides.body: Paper, tape, scissors, bags all on one cart. Roll it out, wrap, roll it back.

slides.title: An under-bed wrap bin
slides.body: Long, flat and lidded. Paper rolls stop getting crushed in the closet.

slides.title: Tape and scissors on a string
slides.body: Tie them to the cart or bin. They can't wander off to the junk drawer.

slides.title: A gift bag holder
slides.body: Flat folders keep bags smooth, so you reuse them instead of buying more.

slides.title: Gift tag labels you can reuse
slides.body: Write names once, stick them on, done. No hunting for a pen mid-wrap.

slides.title: If the tape has a home, the tape stays home.
